description: This file defines the main application logic for an iOS app using SwiftUI. It includes the application delegate managing push notifications, background tasks, and notification handling, as well as the main app structure initializing models, environment, and scene management. It also contains utility functions for handling watch notifications and user notification authorization.

classes.name: OpenClawAppDelegate
classes.description: Application delegate managing launch, remote notifications, background tasks, and watch prompt notifications, integrating with app model for handling device token updates and silent push handling.

methods.name: application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)
methods.description: Initializes background wake refresh registration, sets notification delegate, and registers for remote notifications.

methods.name: application(_:didRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithDeviceToken:)
methods.description: Handles successful remote notification registration by updating app model or storing pending token.

methods.name: application(_:didReceiveRemoteNotification:fetchCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles incoming silent push notifications, scheduling background tasks if the app model is unavailable or not handled.

methods.name: scenePhaseChanged(_:)
methods.description: Schedules background wake refresh when scene moves to background.

methods.name: registerBackgroundWakeRefreshTask()
methods.description: Registers background wake refresh task with the scheduler.

methods.name: scheduleBackgroundWakeRefresh(afterSeconds:reason:)
methods.description: Schedules a background wake refresh task with a specified delay and reason.

methods.name: handleBackgroundWakeRefresh(task:)
methods.description: Performs background refresh via app model, rescheduling task if needed, and handles expiration.

methods.name: isWatchPromptNotification(_:)
methods.description: Checks if a notification is a watch prompt notification.

methods.name: parseWatchPromptAction(from:)
methods.description: Parses a notification response to extract watch prompt action details.

methods.name: routeWatchPromptAction(_:)
methods.description: Routes the parsed watch prompt action to app model or stores it pending if app model is unavailable.

methods.name: userNotificationCenter(_:willPresent:withCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles showing notifications when app is foregrounded, particularly watch prompts.

methods.name: userNotificationCenter(_:didReceive:withCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles user interaction with notifications, routing watch prompt actions accordingly.
